info.name: RingCentral Adaptive Cards Call Recordings API

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

params.name: recordingId
params.description: Internal identifier of a call recording (returned in Call Log)

params.name: contentDisposition
params.description: Whether the content is expected to be displayed in the browser, or downloaded and saved locally

params.name: contentDispositionFilename
params.description: The default filename of the file to be downloaded

items.docs:
Returns media content of a call recording (`audio/mpeg` or `audio/wav`)

**This API must be called via media API entry point, e.g. https://media.ringcentral.com**

params.name: accountId
params.description:
Internal identifier of the RingCentral account
(can be set to "~" to indicate that the account associated with current authorization session should be used)

items.docs:
Deletes company call recordings by their IDs. *Please note:* This method deletes the recording file itself,
not the record of it in the call log.
